no_api_findings.finding: The scoped standard library documents byte and stream I/O (fopen, fread, <stdio.h>) but no MPEG audio frame parser or Layer III decoder. Generic reads return bytes without interpreting frame headers, side information or main data.

limit: This covers the documented ISO C standard library only. POSIX, glibc and platform media frameworks were not inventoried as standard APIs; installed native media libraries such as libmpg123 are third-party package paths. It matches the C finding in data/c/mp3_id3v2/standard.json.
